title: Canonical proper compact rational germs and semilinear moving points
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a proper $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $a_Y:Y\to s$. Use the integral and raw rational constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], ordinary and compact cohomology [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], and the coefficient fibre $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Define the following canonical constructions, without assuming a Weil structure on the coefficient object.

The comparison system is the specified simultaneous integral pullback comparison system [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], evaluated with both coefficient fields equal to $\mathbf Q_\ell$ (represented by its universe lift) and the identity coefficient embedding. For an integral object $M$, define $\varepsilon_M:La_Y^*Ra_{Y*}M\to M$ to be the actual whole-system adjunction counit of the simultaneous-system realization [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]: pullback realization, reconstruction counit, the system geometric counit and inverse completeness unit, in that order; the middle two are formed on quotient systems (the reconstruction counit after the system pullback [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]) and returned by the limit functor of the coefficient sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. For a $k$-point $z:s\to Y$ with $a_Yz=\operatorname{id}_s$, define the integral germ $v_z^M:Ra_{Y*}M\to Lz^*M$ by the inverse identity comparison, the equality $a_Yz=\operatorname{id}_s$, the specified pullback-composition comparison [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], and $Lz^*(\varepsilon_M)$, in that order.

For $M\in D^b_c(Y,E)$, define the compact rational germ $e_z^M:R\Gamma_c(Y,M)\to\operatorname{Fib}_s(Lz^*M)$ by applying $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ to the following composite: the identity-compactification proper comparison $R\Gamma_c\simeq R\Gamma$ before applying $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ [lem-pod-proper-coincidence-frobenius], the scalar-localization image of $v_z^{M_{\mathrm{int}}}$, and the inverse rational pullback object comparison. Here $M_{\mathrm{int}}$ is the underlying object of the raw scalar localization, not a newly chosen representative.

Write $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport] and $g=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times h$ for geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. For any morphism $z:s\to Y$ and $r\in\mathbf N$, define its moving point to be $g^{r+1}z h^{-(r+1)}:s\to Y$, using the positive-power convention of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. This last construction is defined for every such morphism; when $z$ is a $k$-point it is the semilinearly reparametrized point. No semilinear germ identity, naturality theorem, or moving-point property is asserted in this definition node.
